T: Everybody love everybody. Everybody eat everything.
D: Jackie Moon owns, coaches and plays for the Flint Tropics, a 1976 basketball team fighting to survive the merger.
P: Serve the snacks at the Tropics' tip-off.
S: Flint, Michigan, home of the Tropics
Hot dogs in soft buns topped with a dry, finely ground spiced beef coney sauce, mustard and diced onion, the Flint way.
Buttery popcorn with a sprinkle of salt and a dusting of grated parmesan, poured into big striped boxes for the stands.
M: the owner, coach and power forward
Sticky barbecue pork ribs basted until glossy, with buttered corn and coleslaw, a big seventies cookout plate.
W: Light orange sponge layered with vanilla cream, the colour of a Tropics jersey. Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of 2 oranges, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 60ml orange juice.
K: Ice-cold American-style lager served in plastic cups, with lemonade for the kids.

s.note: Flint, Michigan, home of the Tropics
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince until very fine and dry, then add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and 60ml water and cook 10 minutes. Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 hot dog buns with mustard, the coney sauce and diced onion.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a large pot, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake until popping stops. Toss with 50g melted butter, salt flakes and 30g finely grated parmesan.

m.note: the owner, coach and power forward
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, wrap in foil and bake at 160C for 2 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Serve with 4 buttered corn cobs and 1 bag coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of 2 oranges, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 60ml orange juice. Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill and top with 300ml cream whipped with vanilla.

d.how: Chill 8 cans of lager in an esky full of ice for an hour. Pour into plastic cups and serve straight away, with cold lemonade for anyone not drinking.
